messages:
cheng: quick sync — fallback compatibility matrix: tokenizer / context / tool-calling parity. pinging @sara @kevin to triage.
sara: repro steps? which variants and region?
cheng: happened during eu-west failover: 32k-context variant routed -> 8k fallback. tool-calls lost function signatures and we got token truncation in user prompts. logs in thread.
kevin: hmm likely kv-cache offset + tokenizer vocab mismatch. quantized path also toggles tokenization on some model builds. router needs explicit compatibility checks.
maria: UX note — console rollout page should surface an "incompatibility risk" flag per variant pair. also a link to tokenization diff preview.
cheng: quick sketch of the matrix:
```
Variant | Tokenizer | Context | Tool-call | Safe-fallback?
v1-32k  | bpe-v2    | 32k     | yes       | no
v1-8k   | bpe-v2    | 8k      | yes       | partial (KV)
v2-8k   | bpe-v1    | 8k      | no        | no (toolcalls)
```
kevin: we should formalize three checks: tokenizer-vocab-hash, kv-cache-offset-compat, toolcall-schema-hash. if any fail mark unsafe and block canary -> fallback to same-arch family only.
sara: telemetry request: add metric `fallback_incompatibility_count` with labels {region,tier,route,from_variant,to_variant,result}. alert when > threshold for a route.
cheng: agreed. event payload idea: `fallback_compat_check{from=v1-32k,to=v1-8k,region=eu-west,tier=standard,result=kv_offset_mismatch}`. example emit: 
```
curl -X POST https://telemetry.internal/events -d '{"name":"fallback_compat_check","labels":{"from":"v1-32k","to":"v1-8k","result":"kv_offset_mismatch"}}'
```
maria: console UX: show yellow warning on rollout page + "force-unsafe-fallback" button gated by SRE approval. also surface a small token diff preview and sample truncated prompt.
kevin: implementation note: router currently checks model family + quantization. extend router-preflight to compare tokenizer hash + tool-schema hash. add an allowlist for documented intentional mismatches.
sara: can we add an e2e in eng-infra that simulates region failover and exercises tokenizer + toolcall paths? short test should fail the rollback if incompat detected.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: queued job fallback-checker/e2e-sim v0.1 (canary) :gear:
cheng: I'll draft the matrix PR and open console ticket. assigning @kevin for router changes and @sara for telemetry/alerts. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
